name: Ningaloo Marine Interactions
summary: Owner-operated snorkel tours from Coral Bay on Ningaloo Reef, running since 2011. The full-day trips use a spotter aircraft to help find manta rays, whale sharks, humpback whales and other wildlife. Groups are no more than 20 guests, and the crew adds photos from each tour to a manta ray catalogue started in 2006.
standouts: Owner-operated by Frazer McGregor and Colin Walker, running eco tours from Coral Bay since 2011
Co-owner and skipper Frazer McGregor founded the Ningaloo Manta Project
No more than 20 guests on each tour
A spotter aircraft helps find wildlife on all four tours

contact.address: Shop 13 Coral Bay Arcade, Robinson Street, Coral Bay WA 6701

trips.title: ‘Best of Ningaloo’ Full Day Manta Ray Marine Adventure
trips.summary: A full-day snorkel trip from Coral Bay aboard Utopia, a shallow-draft boat with a shaded deck, searching for manta rays with the help of a spotter aircraft. Between swims the crew snorkels coral gardens, and turtles, dolphins, sharks and dugong may be seen. Guests can take part in manta research and name any newly found mantas.
highlights: Spotter aircraft helps find manta rays
Aboard Utopia, with a shaded deck and flybridge seating
Snorkelling on coral gardens, with other wildlife possible

The trip is named 'Best of Ningaloo Tour: Manta Rays and more!' on the home page and 'Best of Ningaloo: Manta Rays, Sharks and Turtle Tours' on the fleet page; the title used is the heading on its own page. Run on Utopia (maximum 20 guests per the fleet page). The home page card mentions tiger sharks for this tour but the tour page does not. The site claims manta rays are around all year; not repeated here.

trips.title: Whale Shark Odyssey
trips.summary: A full-day whale shark snorkel tour from Coral Bay aboard West End II, a twin-hull catamaran, with a designated spotter plane to help find the sharks. The crew adapts the day to ocean conditions rather than following a fixed plan, and snorkels coral gardens along the way. Guides talk about whale shark ecology and behaviour. It runs from April to June.
highlights: Designated spotter plane included in the price
Aboard West End II, a twin-hull catamaran
Guides explain whale shark ecology and behaviour
Reef snorkelling as well as whale shark swims

trips.title: Humpback Whale Adventure
trips.summary: A full-day humpback whale trip from Coral Bay aboard West End II, a reef-friendly catamaran, with a spotter plane helping the search. Guests can choose whale watching only, whale watching with outer reef snorkelling, or add a swim with the whales when the opportunity arises. In-water swims are regulated and depend on the whales, and the crew switches to watching from the boat when that is the better choice.
highlights: Whale watch only, whale watch with snorkelling, or add a swim
Hot hamburger lunch with vegan, vegetarian and gluten free options

trips.title: Ningaloo Marine Safari
trips.summary: A full-day snorkel trip from Coral Bay aboard West End II, run in the shoulder season. The crew follows the day's wildlife rather than a script, with a spotter plane assisting the search and stops on coral gardens. Lunch is provided.
highlights: Aboard West End II, a twin-hull catamaran
includes: Tea, coffee or chilled water on board
Link to complimentary photos of your day
